data.title: 伊雷娜 · 夜间魔法星夜
data.description: 夜色笼罩长满青草的山丘，伊蕾娜挥动魔杖，将点点星芒汇成漂浮的星座光球。流星从深蓝天幕划过，远处营地的火光映着她的魔女装。她看着自己的小小星空露出得意的笑容——「把今晚的星光留在旅途中，也是很不错的纪念吧。」
data.action: 在夜间草丘挥动魔杖，施展汇聚星光的魔法
data.lighting: 山坡上淡金魔法星点照亮手和脸，坡下帐篷外的篝火是远处小暖光
data.promptProse: On a grassy hill above camp, Elaina holds her wand just higher than shoulder level. A few pale-gold points of light hang directly above its tip, linked by fine lines like a small constellation. She watches the shape with a satisfied smile, her smoke-purple capelet stirred by the breeze. At the bottom of the slope a canvas tent sits beside one small amber campfire. A lone meteor streak crosses the clear blue sky over the dark outline of the far hills. The wide framing keeps the near blades of grass, the caster and the low camp in distinct planes.
data.animaCaption: A handful of pale gold points linked by fine lines hangs just above her raised wand. The small campfire stays downhill beside the tent under a single meteor streak.
